updates.title: Cool Covers on board
updates.text: A big thank you to Cool Covers for coming on board as the latest official supporter. Anyone who has spent a long day in the saddle knows how warm it can get. Cool Covers make motorbike seat covers with a 3D mesh that lets air flow between the rider and the seat.

updates.title: Thank you, Oxford Products
updates.text: Oxford Products is supporting the ride. Oxford makes motorcycle gear, luggage and accessories, and having the right kit makes all the difference when you are clocking up the miles.

updates.title: IAM RoadSmart on board
updates.text: We are proud to have IAM RoadSmart, the UK road safety charity, supporting oliMoto. Their work on advanced rider training and road safety makes them a fantastic supporter to have alongside us.

updates.title: The Adventure Bike Shop on board
updates.text: The Adventure Bike Shop is helping with motorcycle accessories. Founders Cliff and Jenny Batley spent a year travelling overland by motorcycle through Europe, the Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, New Zealand and Australia. As Joe put it: a few more bits of equipment ticked off the list.
updates.alt: Official supporter graphic: The Adventure Bike Shop

updates.title: The bikes are here
updates.text: Our Honda CB125R and Honda NX500 have arrived, a week after Oli passed his A1 licence. Everyone we spoke to told us to ride Hondas. For us they show that a company as big as Honda believes in us and trusts us to achieve our goals. Thank you Honda UK and Shirlaws.
updates.alt: The new Hondas on a trailer outside the dealership

updates.title: Oli passes his A1 test
updates.text: The biggest milestone so far, and the one we could not go on our adventure without. Oli passed module 1 and module 2 and now holds his A1 licence: one step closer to the big adventure.
updates.alt: Oli and his instructor with the bike after passing module 1, and again after module 2

updates.title: An evening with John McGuinness
updates.text: Our evening with John McGuinness sold out. All funds raised on the night go directly to Save the Children UK. Thank you to everyone who bought a ticket.
updates.alt: John McGuinness in front of a globe with the route drawn on it, and a SOLD OUT stamp

updates.title: Front cover of the Piper
updates.text: oliMoto made the front cover of the Deeside and Donside Piper and Herald, with a full feature inside on the story behind our father and son adventure.
updates.alt: Newspaper front page headed 'Honda backs father and son's adventure', with Oli and Joe at Shirlaws Motorcycles

updates.title: Looking for a title sponsor
updates.text: This week the story was featured in Motorcycle News and Visordown, with support from Honda UK on social media. What started as an idea on the drive home from ABR Festival is now attracting real attention, so we're looking for a title sponsor: a brand that wants to be part of the adventure and the story.
updates.alt: Oli and Joe in Honda jackets outside the Honda dealership

updates.title: In Motorcycle News
updates.text: MCN has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. I grew up seeing my dad read it. I am too late to share this moment with my dad, but being able to share it with my son makes it very special. (Joe)
updates.alt: Oli and Joe on their bikes at dusk, behind a 'What's on the news?' graphic

updates.title: A message from the Chief Scout
updates.text: Dwayne Fields, Chief Scout: "Oli's journey will show other young people what can be achieved when you are prepared to set yourself a big goal and work hard to make it happen."
updates.alt: Dwayne Fields, Chief Scout, wearing a Scout scarf

updates.title: Oli's first lesson on a 125
updates.text: Day 1 of learning to ride a 125cc with 121 MotoSkills. Thanks to Pete for making it such a fun and enjoyable experience. Oli loved the upgrade from his 50cc bike.
updates.alt: Oli's instructor in a hi-vis vest at the start of the lesson

updates.title: £2,000 raised
updates.text: Behind that number are people who have chosen to believe in what we're doing. We're now 10% of the way to our fundraising goal for Save the Children. £2,000 down, 90% to go.
updates.alt: Thank you graphic: £2,000 raised, 10% of the target

updates.title: Where oliMoto began
updates.text: It began with a simple bond, formed across muddy tracks, snowy mountain tops, and every adventure in between. For one, this is the adventure of a lifetime. For the other, it's the beginning of a lifetime of adventures.
updates.alt: Joe and Oli sitting on their motorbikes at dusk

updates.title: LinkTree
updates.text: We have now created a Linktree to all our social media.

updates.title: Mission Creep
updates.text: We attended the Aberdeen Car Show at the weekend and had a fantastic time. Our goal was to promote our project and, hopefully, raise sponsorship funds and donations for Save the Children.

updates.title: Instagram
updates.text: We are now on Instagram. Use the QR code to follow our story.

updates.title: Thanks Charley
updates.text: Well, that was a little bit surreal, watching and listening to Oli discussing round-the-world motorbike route options with Charley Boorman!

updates.title: LOMO Support
updates.text: We are hugely excited to announce the support of LOMO, a Glasgow based company offering a fantastic range of high-quality, great-value equipment.

updates.title: A Dream Worth Chasing?
updates.text: It has been fascinating to spread the word about our adventure.

updates.title: Route Clarification
updates.text: We have been contacted by several concerned friends over the past few days regarding the arrest and sentencing of the British round-the-world motorcycling couple, Craig and Lindsay Foreman, in Iran.

updates.title: Aberdeen Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow
updates.text: We had an interesting evening last night at the Aberdeen Motorcycle Road Safety Roadshow learning about accident prevention, first aid and the legal claims.

updates.title: JustGiving Page Published
updates.text: Our JustGiving page has gone live with links added to the website and details of how we will manage charity donations and sponsorship.

updates.title: Charity Update
updates.text: It gives us great pleasure to announce that we will be working with Save the Children to help raise awareness of the vital work they do and to raise funds before, during, and after our adventure.

updates.title: Charity Contributions and Funding
updates.text: Since the beginning of the project, we have been researching and speaking with a range of organisations to identify a charity to support.

updates.title: Social Media
updates.text: We now have several social media channels up and running, including Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

updates.title: Practice Begins
updates.text: We have around 18 months to practice road skills. This is Oli out on his Bullit Hero with Joe riding behind giving instruction and advice through the Cardo intercom.

updates.title: CBT Completed
updates.text: Oli aced his Compulsory Basic Training with the help of the Biketec Motorcycle Training from Aberdeen.
